result_text:
The new oauth-proxy failure has the same cause as the api-key one. It isn't from my change.

"should work with database mode + UUID" fails with `ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432`, so it needs a Postgres instance. The other 27 tests in that file pass.

Every failure the hook has reported so far comes from this environment: Postgres isn't running and the sandbox has no network.

| Test | What it needs |
|---|---|
| `@better-auth/api-key` `src/api-key.test.ts` | Postgres |
| `oauth-proxy.test.ts` "database mode + UUID" | Postgres |
| `social.test.ts` "should refresh the access token" | access to `accounts.google.com` |

I haven't edited or skipped any of them. The hook will keep failing until it runs with Postgres and network access, or those tests are excluded from its run.

My change is finished: `session.ts` and the two new tests in `session-api.test.ts`. That file's 69 tests pass.
